benchmark_metadata.title: Document Intelligence & Hybrid RAG Benchmark (10-organisation demo corpus)
benchmark_metadata.description: 156 questions over the 200-document fictional corpus generated by scripts/generate_sample_data.py (10 organisations x 20 documents). The first 50 questions are hand-written; the rest are generated together with their documents (source = generated). answer_keywords are case-insensitive substrings that must appear in a correct answer; expected_page is the PDF page or PPTX slide number.

test_cases.question: How many days of annual leave do employees get under the 2026 leave policy?
test_cases.reference_answer: Under the 2026 leave policy (POL-HR-017), every confirmed employee is entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per leave year.

test_cases.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for employees who use their own car for official travel?
test_cases.reference_answer: Employees using their own car are reimbursed at ₹12 per kilometre (₹6 per kilometre for a two-wheeler).

test_cases.question: Within how many days must the Internal Committee complete its inquiry into a sexual harassment complaint?
test_cases.reference_answer: The Internal Committee must complete its inquiry within 90 days of receiving the complaint.

test_cases.question: What is the initial term of version 2 of the Master Services Agreement with Orchid Retail Ventures?
test_cases.reference_answer: Version 2 of the MSA has an initial term of 36 months from the effective date of 1 July 2026, renewing automatically for 12-month periods thereafter.

test_cases.question: What is the response time for a P1 critical incident under the service level agreement?
test_cases.reference_answer: Under SLA-2026-118, P1 critical incidents have a response time of 15 minutes and a resolution target of 4 hours.

test_cases.question: Within how many hours must Helix notify Healthbridge Diagnostics of a personal data breach under the data processing agreement?
test_cases.reference_answer: The processor must notify the controller without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.

test_cases.question: What is the maximum attachment size per file in HelixDesk?
test_cases.reference_answer: The maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file, with up to 10 files per reply.

test_cases.question: How many participants will be enrolled in the GLYCO-SHIELD clinical trial, and across how many sites?
test_cases.reference_answer: GLYCO-SHIELD will enrol 640 participants across 12 sites in India, randomised 1:1 to Glucoverin XR or placebo.

test_cases.question: What is the hospital's target for hand hygiene compliance?
test_cases.reference_answer: The hospital's hand hygiene compliance target is 90%, measured by monthly direct observation audits.

test_cases.question: What was Helix Systems' revenue from operations in Q2 FY2026-27 according to the quarterly financial report?
test_cases.reference_answer: Revenue from operations was Rs. 48.6 crore in Q2 FY2026-27, up 14.2% from Rs. 42.6 crore a year earlier.

test_cases.question: How many duplicate vendor records did the internal audit find in the vendor master?
test_cases.reference_answer: The internal audit (IA-2026-03) found 17 duplicate vendor records in the ERP vendor master, a high-risk observation.

test_cases.question: Which team won HackOrion 2026 and what did they build?
test_cases.reference_answer: Team ByteBrigade won HackOrion 2026 with a voice-based ticket logging assistant in Kannada and Hindi for field technicians, winning ₹2,50,000.

test_cases.question: Under the latest rules, how much time off can a dad take when his baby is born?
test_cases.reference_answer: Under the 2026 policy, male employees get 10 working days of paid paternity leave, which can be taken in up to two blocks within 6 months of the birth.

test_cases.question: After I get back from a work trip, how long do I have to ask for my money back?
test_cases.reference_answer: Travel claims must be submitted in the BrightpathHR Expense module within 30 days of trip completion; claims more than 60 days late are rejected.

test_cases.question: What is the most a present from someone we do business with can be worth before I have to report it?
test_cases.reference_answer: Gifts may be accepted only up to ₹2,000 per occasion; anything above ₹2,000 must be declared to the Ethics Office within 5 working days.

test_cases.question: How much refundable money did we hand over to the landlord of the new office building?
test_cases.reference_answer: Tejas paid an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 67,50,000, equal to 6 months' rent, for the Whitefield premises.

test_cases.question: If the platform is reachable for less than 95% of a month, what discount does the retail client get on that month's bill?
test_cases.reference_answer: Availability below 95.0% entitles the client to a service credit of 20% of the monthly fee (credits are capped at 25% per month).

test_cases.question: For how long should the heart-attack patient keep taking his second blood thinner after the stent was put in?
test_cases.reference_answer: Ticagrelor 90 mg twice daily is to be continued for 12 months, alongside lifelong aspirin.

test_cases.question: When someone's sugar drops too low but they are awake, how many grams of quick carbs should they have first?
test_cases.reference_answer: Following the rule of 15, a conscious patient takes 15 grams of fast-acting carbohydrate and rechecks blood glucose after 15 minutes.

test_cases.question: What alert is announced in the hospital when a baby goes missing?
test_cases.reference_answer: Code Pink is announced for an infant or child abduction, and all exits are sealed immediately.

test_cases.question: How many people were on the company's payroll at the end of the July-to-September quarter?
test_cases.reference_answer: Total headcount was 1,184 employees as of 30 September 2026, up from 1,092 at 30 June 2026.

test_cases.reference_answer: Rohit Deshmukh reduced the average release pipeline time for the HelixDesk monorepo from 45 minutes to 8 minutes.
